nina_csm: Scheduling NovaHealth dedicated pool bring-up Thurs 08:30 PDT. Need quota signoff, autoscale gating, and a targeted load-test. Renewal risk = medium if we miss perf SLOs. Can infra + ops attend?

omar_infra: I can. What traffic profile?

nina_csm: Baseline 150 concurrent sessions, 3x 5m spikes to 350cc. Avg seq 450, long-tail to 1200 on analytics. Customer SLO: p95 <140ms.

omar_infra: Start fleet: 6 x A100. Autoscale draft: add +2 GPUs when avg_gpu_util > 72% for 180s; scale down -1 when <38% for 10m. Prewarm: replay 60k prefixes.

rachel_ops: I'll queue prewarm job warm-6167 and LR loadjob lr-6167. Enable PD alert if scale fails to add within 5m.

sre_bot: warm job warm-6167 submitted. LR job lr-6167 queued. Artifacts -> s3://redwood/nova/lr-6167/*.

paul_support: Enablement: 20m SRE walkthrough + 10m customer handoff after first run. I'll create invite and share runbook.

omar_infra: Fallbacks: 13b-q4_0 overflow, 7b-q4 emergency. Plan staged rollout: enable q4 overflow at T+8m after traffic cut to observe quality.

nina_csm: Acceptance criteria: (1) p95 <=160ms for >=95% of 30m soak; (2) error rate <=0.6%; (3) autoscale events observed and fill within 3m.

karen_fin: I'll validate cost envelope; >10% over target => escalate renewal risk.

paul_support: Post-run owner? I'll compile notes, perf graphs, and JIRA epic. ETA 18h post-run.

rachel_ops: Preflight smoke at T-5m. Load plan: ramp 10m -> steady 20m @150cc -> three 5m spikes to 350cc, 10m recovery between spikes.

sre_bot: Reminder: warm-6167 starts 30m prior; lr-6167 preflight 5m before.

omar_infra: I'll monitor first two runs and be oncall.

nina_csm: Invite sent to customer and internal leads. Closing thread unless changes. :rocket:
